about.description: A small archive that runs locally on your computer and organizes your lecture notes, slides and PDFs by course.
app.description: libzie: a local archive that organizes your lecture notes and PDFs by course
delete.hint: Files aren't permanently deleted; they're moved to the .silinenler folder. You can restore them with “Undo” in the notification or from File Explorer.
delete.title_folder: Delete the folder “{name}” and everything in it?
empty.hint: Drag files here or upload them.

err.icon_course_only: Icons can only be given to courses
err.move_into_self: A folder can't be moved into itself
err.open_blocked: This file type isn't opened directly for security reasons (it may be executable). Use “Show in folder”.

keys.arrows: Move between tiles, cards and rows
keys.delete: Delete (asks for confirmation, can be undone with “Undo”)
keys.escape: Close the menu, return to the file browser
keys.fullscreen: Make the open file full screen / exit full screen
keys.pdf_note: While a PDF is open, the page, zoom and print buttons are in the browser's own PDF toolbar. After you click the PDF, Esc and the shortcuts go to it; click the “Files” tab to return to the browser.
keys.search: Search; searches inside the current course
keys.search_all: Search all courses; <kbd>Enter</kbd> opens the first result
search.hint: Search ( / ) · Search all courses ( Ctrl+K ) · Enter opens the first result
search.label: Search
set.lang_hint: Interface language. “Automatic” follows your system language.
set.root_empty_hint: Leave empty to use the default folder.
set.root_help: Your courses are stored in this folder. You can paste the Google Drive folder of your Notability backup here, for example G:\My Drive\Notability. In File Explorer, select the folder and Shift+right-click → “Copy as path” to get its path.
set.root_locked: This folder is pinned by the KAYNAK_KLASORU environment variable and can't be changed here.
set.root_placeholder: Leave empty to use the default folder
set.root_preview: This folder contains {c} course folder(s) and {f} file(s).
set.theme_hint: The app's color scheme. “System” follows your computer's light/dark preference.
set.tray_desktop_only: Only available in the desktop app
set.tray_help: libzie stays in the system tray; click the icon to open the window, or right-click it to quit completely.
set.tray_label: Keep running in the background when the window is closed
tray.hint: libzie keeps running in the background. Click the icon to open it again.
upd.auto_help: When checked, libzie looks for a new version every time it starts, downloads it if there is one and restarts. This setting is saved immediately.
upd.auto_label: Install new versions automatically on startup
upd.auto_unavailable: There is no automatic update when running from source
upd.err.asset_missing: The download for this release isn't ready yet; try again in a few minutes.
upd.err.auto_tried: This version was already tried automatically; update manually from Settings.
upd.err.bad_url: Unexpected download address; the update was cancelled.
upd.err.checksum_bad: The downloaded file failed verification; try again.
upd.err.from_source: You can't update from inside the app when running from source; update the repository with git pull.
upd.err.in_progress: An update is already in progress.
upd.err.incomplete: The downloaded file is incomplete; try again.
upd.err.no_checksum: This release has no verification checksum; the update was not applied for security reasons.
upd.err.not_app: The downloaded file is not a valid application.
upd.err.not_writable: Can't write to {dir}; move the app to a writable folder or use the installer version.
upd.err.offline: Could not get version information; check your internet connection.
upd.err.rate_limited: GitHub is not accepting requests right now; try again shortly.
upd.err.unreadable: Could not read the version information.
upd.err.up_to_date: libzie is already up to date.
upd.heading: Updates
upd.installing: Installing the new version; libzie will reopen shortly…
upd.new_from_source: A new version is available. Since you are running from source, update the repository with git pull.
upd.new_not_ready: A new version exists, but its download isn't ready yet; check again in a few minutes.
